fact_sheet: Dad tells Maya the story of how he met Mom.
Setting: Meridian Soft Bay Area trip, Grand Oriole Hotel, Silverleaf Mall.
Cast: Rohan, Elena, Maya, Kabir, Arjun, Wei, Marcus Hale.
Beats: butterflies, tram silence, head-bonk, Limbo Date, feather talk.
Frame: Dad beside daughter on the sofa — no book.
narrative_summary: Dad tells Maya how he met Mom: shy IT guy Rohan keeps crossing paths with Elena on a Bay Area work trip. Silence becomes cafeteria talk, long walks, a cancelled club night, and a nervously tender hotel-room movie. A Sunday movie day peaks the crush; he asks for honesty with a Limbo Date. Feelings are known by the end. To Be Continued.
